description: Información de transporte y almacenamiento de Gas Natural (2026) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía (SENER). El volumen de Gas Natural transportado y almacenado en los sistemas permisionados, incluido el Sistema de Transporte y Almacenamiento Nacional Integrado de Gas Natural. La capacidad utilizada y disponible en las instalaciones y ductos de las personas Permisionarias. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía (SENER). Its tags are depósito gas, distribución gas, extracción gas natural, fuente energética, generación energía. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
